== Description ==

[[Barry Alperstein]] (left, green Mordor shirt) playing [[Ryan French]] (right, grey Darth Vader shirt and glasses) while [[Mike French]] (standing center, grey hoodie) watches at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
